title: Learning to Grade Efficiently: A Bandit-Driven Prompt-Selection Framework for Low-Cost LLM Essay Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2608.23814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in automated essay scoring (AES), but contemporary approaches typically employ fixed prompt selection, failing to address operational cost concerns and evolving optimal configurations. We propose a novel cost-aware approach that treats each prompt type as an arm in a multi-armed bandit (MAB) controller, enabling adaptive selection of optimal prompting strategies during inference. Our experiments on IELTS Writing Task 2 essays show that the MAB framework achieves comparable scoring accuracy to exhaustive grid search while reducing LLM calls by 78.4\% to find the best grading approach. We implemented four distinct grading recipes (multi-step vs. single-step assessment, with vs. without calibration examples) and found that the multi-step approach with examples achieves the highest accuracy. translated_title: 学习高效评分：基于多臂老虎机驱动的提示选择框架，用于低成本LLM作文评分
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23814v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动作文评分（AES）中展现出强大能力，但当代方法通常采用固定提示选择，未能解决运营成本问题和不断演变的最优配置。我们提出了一种新颖的成本感知方法，将每种提示类型视为多臂老虎机（MAB）控制器中的一个臂，从而在推理过程中自适应选择最优提示策略。我们在雅思写作任务2作文上的实验表明，MAB框架在实现与穷举网格搜索相当的评分准确性的同时，将寻找最佳评分方法的LLM调用次数减少了78.4%。我们实施了四种不同的评分配方（多步与单步评估，带与不带校准示例），发现带示例的多步方法实现了最高准确性。通过跟踪令牌使用和延迟以及一致性指标，我们生成了首个成本-准确度-效率的综合评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多臂老虎机的自适应提示选择框架，在保持评分准确性的同时将LLM调用成本降低了78.4%，并首次综合评估了成本、准确度和效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bandit-driven adaptive prompt-selection framework that reduces LLM calls by 78.4% while maintaining scoring accuracy, and provides the first comprehensive cost-accuracy-efficiency evaluation.
